{{Quote|At 21:23:07 yesterday, materials were posted to this forum which potentially violated security parameters. Cularin holonet services hereby suspends this forum until further notice. Any individuals contributing further to this discussion will be brought in for questioning.|holosrv, posting on the Cularin holonet node|<ref name="destabilization" />}}
The handle '''holosrv''' was used as the ID of an individual who worked for [[Cularin holonet services]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Operation False Horizon]], a heated discussion occurred on a [[Cularin holonet node]] forum following the disclosure by the user [[Tiny.f]] of a purported [[Thaereian military]] plot to cause economic and social disruption in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. The next [[Standard day/Legends|day]], Cularin holonet services suspended the forum and holosrv submitted a follow-up post proclaiming that the information posted by Tiny.f may have breached security rules. Holosrv also warned that any individuals who engaged in further discussion regarding the alleged [[Thaereian]] scheme would be detained.<ref name="destabilization" />

Sometime later, the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[mstrslcr]] shared on the Cularin holonet node a decrypted message from an unknown party that had been transmitted from the<ref name="academic review">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20041007|text=Academic Review}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Almas]] to<ref name="academic review" /> the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world<ref name="DB">{{DB|location|coruscant|Coruscant}}</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. This triggered debate among users of the forum, who speculated that the communique had been sent by representatives of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and proposed intervention in the operation of the [[Almas Academy|Jedi academy]] on Almas. The next day, Cularin holonet services suspended the forum and holosrv proclaimed that the report shared by mstrslcr violated security protocols and beings who discussed the matter further would be apprehended.<ref name="academic review" />
